Our client is a well-established and international financial services organization, recognized for its expertise, client-centric approach, and strong reputation within the wealth management sector.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage client onboarding and KYC documentation.

Coordinator and interface between the chip manufacturing plants and our customers.
 

What you will do
 

The world of chip manufacturing is an interesting and diverse environment. Our enthusiastic and diverse team collaborates with imec’s customers to make their projects become reality. We are eager to welcome new team members to step into this magnificent world and get familiar with the processes of manufacturing chips. 
 

IC-link by Imec (https://www.imec-int.com/en/ic-link) helps customers to design chips and bring them to the prototype and the mass production stage at top chip foundries. Imec offers state-of-the-art prototype and volume fabrication services to fabless companies and system houses. Imec IC-link provides its customers specialized technical solutions for the design of chips, prototyping and mass production. 
 

As a chip manufacturing support engineer, you are the coordinator and interface between the chip manufacturing plants and our customers. After an extensive training by our team, you get the responsibility of the entire process of tape out of the custom chips designed by our customers. In this tape out process, you will handle the following tasks: 
 
 

• Check and guarantee the quality of chips, designer by our international customers. You do this based on the documentation provided by the manufacturing plants and knowledge you gain from the team and past projects 

• Prepare the chip design for fabrication at the foundries and help the customer with final sign-off (‘go’ for fabrication). You do this with the help of the most advanced EDA tools. 

• Have technical discussions with our customers to guide them in this sign-off process. 

• Guide the customer in getting the required foundry information and documentation before, during and after the chip design and manufacturing. 

• Follow up the projects from start to end and assure that all project milestones are met. 

• Assist the sales team in technical discussions. 

• Have technical discussions with the production plants that manufacture these chips.  

Who you are
 
 

• We are looking for candidates with a Master of engineering degree in electronics (“industrial engineer”) or equivalent by experience with some background as a layout engineer  

• Knowledge of python/perl/tcl is an asset  

• We attach great importance to the following core competence: taking initiative, being client-oriented, being punctual, teamwork and drive.  

• We expect that you are a strong communicator and can speak and write English fluently enough to support our international customers.  

• You can adequately judge problem situations, recognize priorities and act accordingly in a flexible manner.  

• Knowledge of Dynamics 365 tools is an added asset.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

Our client is an international organization based in Zaventem, supporting operations across Europe in sectors such as automotive, industrial, energy, and materials.
 

As a Finance & Accounting Specialist, you will support day-to-day accounting activities, month-end closings, reporting processes, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives while working closely with colleagues across the business.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

Sales & Purchase Accounting
 

 
• Support the Sales Department with accounting treatment, SAP bookings, and invoice reviews.
 
• Review outgoing invoices and maintain accounting procedures and manuals.
 
• Expenses & Invoice Management
 
• Process expense invoices and bank transactions in SAP.
 
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-related queries.
 
• Review and process employee expense claims via SAP Concur.
 
• Keep procedures up to date and contribute to process improvements and Kaizen initiatives. 
 

General Accounting Support
 

 
• Assist with monthly closings and reporting.
 
• Perform reconciliations, bank postings, account reviews, and follow-up on open items.
 
• Support invoice booking and resolve accounting discrepancies.
 
• Prepare documentation for audits 
 
• Provide backup support for payments, banking, foreign exchange, and other finance-related activities.
 
• Support the Accounting Manager with accruals,  

Your Profile
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 
• Approximately 2 to 3 years of relevant accounting experience.
 
• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
 
• Experience working with SAP is a strong asset.
 
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
 
• Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
 
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement attitude.
 
• Able to work independently while being a strong team player.
 
• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management abilities.
 
• Fluent in English, with a good knowledge of Dutch and French.

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)
